title: Composed majority split equivalence
statement: For a natural number $m$, the set of sign assignments on $2+(2m+1)$ coordinates is equivalent to the product of the set of sign assignments on two coordinates and the set of sign assignments on $2m+1$ coordinates, by splitting the coordinates into these two blocks.
